opinion.headline: Why Aparigraha is Jainism's most relevant lesson today
opinion.hook: Jain philosophy teaches that nothing remains permanent, urging detachment from material possessions.
opinion.summary: This principle of Aparigraha aimed to curb consumption and thus reduce violence. Historically, Jain merchants supported monasticism, balancing wealth circulation with spiritual values. Modern times see a shift away from these teachings, risking societal resentment. The philosophy offers a quiet warning about hoarding and the necessity of plurality.
